jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Model Risk Management
jobs.location: OFF GBR: London (Sancroft)
jobs.description: Job Purpose With approximately 5 million contracts cleared every day across multiple asset classes, ICE Clear Europe (ICEU) is one of the world’s most diverse and leading clearing houses. As a clearing house, ICEU performs a critical role in ensuring market stability especially through periods of volatility and increased uncertainty. It provides central counterparty clearing and risk management services for global energy, interest rate, equity index, and agricultural derivatives. We leverage advanced quantitative models to effectively manage market risk for exchange-traded derivatives, credit risk of clearing members and counterparties, and liquidity risk associated with posted collateral. Our risk framework ensures resilience in dynamic market conditions while upholding the highest regulatory and operational standards. The Model Risk Management team, part of the Risk Oversight Department, is responsible for all aspects of model risk, encompassing model governance & control, model validation, and model performance monitoring across a wide range of applications. ICE Clear Europe is seeking a Senior Model Risk Analyst to join its Model Risk Management team. This role is responsible for validating and monitoring pricing and risk models used in the clearing house, ensuring their accuracy, robustness, and compliance with regulatory standards. The position involves end-to-end model risk assessment across initial margin, add-ons, and stress testing frameworks, with a focus on market, credit, and liquidity risk. This is an exciting opportunity for a technical expert looking for broad model exposure in a collaborative and flat organizational structure at the centre of financial markets. Responsibilities Conduct independent validation of risk and pricing models and review of stress testing frameworks, including conceptual soundness, assumption reasonableness, and performance benchmarking. Document validation findings, communicate risks, and recommend improvements. Continuously monitor model performance, review first-line risk management monitoring approaches, and identify and drive model changes or risk mitigating actions. Provide guidance on model usage and act as a key stakeholder liaison for new models and changes Review model change and calibration proposals Stay updated on evolving market practices, regulatory requirements, and quantitative methodologies. Provide technical interpretations to regulatory text Utilise programming skills to execute validation tasks and develop technical capabilities and tools for model testing, model monitoring and other related analytics. Knowledge and Experience Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) in Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, or related field. Experience in model validation, quantitative analysis, or risk analytics. Strong knowledge of market, credit, or liquidity risk frameworks. Proficiency in Python (NumPy, Pandas, etc.) and SQL for data analysis. Strong understanding of option pricing theory and statistical risk modelling techniques (VaR, Backtesting, Stress Testing). Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Desirable Knowledge and Experience Industry certifications (PRM, FRM, CFA). Experience in a clearing house, trading firm, bank or similar financial institution. Knowledge of SR 11-7 model risk guidelines and exchange-traded derivatives.

jobs.title: Business Continuity Operations Analyst II
jobs.location: OFF IND: TG Hyderabad (Skyview)
jobs.description: Job Purpose The Business Continuity Operations Analyst is a dual-function role embedded within daily operations while owning the lifecycle of BC/DR planning, testing, and readiness. You will provide direct support to engineering, IT, and business teams to minimize disruption impact while simultaneously assisting with developing and maintaining the plans, assessments, and exercises that ensure ICE can sustain critical operations through any scenario. This is a 24x7 environment; the position may require weekend scheduling and shift flexibility. Responsibilities Operations & Incident Management • Own incidents end-to-end: communication, escalation, follow-up, and root-cause analysis (RCA) documentation. • Quickly assess incidents and provide management with well-conceived short- and long-term service restoration actions. • Work with internal partners to communicate and address concerns across business units. • Follow organizational practices for Incident Management; maintain accurate records in ServiceNow. Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery • Support the creation, documentation, and maintenance of Business Continuity Plans (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies across assigned business segments. • Assist in conducting Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and risk assessments to identify critical business functions, dependencies, and vulnerabilities. • Coordinate and participate in regular BC/DR tests, tabletop exercises, and simulation drills; document results and track remediation actions. • Maintain plan repositories, contact lists, and exercise records; prepare post-exercise reports and readiness summaries for stakeholders. • Provide operational support during actual continuity events, including communications, escalation tracking, and incident documentation. Training, Documentation & Awareness • Assist in training employees on emergency response procedures, continuity protocols, and incident escalation paths. • Prepare and maintain troubleshooting guides, escalation runbooks, and procedural documentation for both operational and BC scenarios. • Support awareness programs that keep business units informed of their continuity obligations and current plan status. Knowledge and Experience Bachelor's degree (or Associate's degree with relevant experience) in Information Technology, Business Continuity, Risk Management, or a related field. 2-4 years of experience in IT operations, systems/application support, business continuity, or risk management. Operational Aptitude: Ability to remain organized and decisive under pressure when managing urgent, critical production issues. Analytical Thinking: Logical, root-cause-oriented approach to both technical troubleshooting and business process risk assessment. Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to interface effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. Reliability: Demonstrates flexibility, attention to detail, and follow-through on both operational and program responsibilities. Team Orientation: Able to work independently and collaboratively; willing to assist outside of defined role boundaries when the situation calls for it Preferred Experience with financial markets, trading systems, or clearing operations. Hands-on experience with ServiceNow (Incident, Problem, Change, and/or BC modules). Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and automation platforms: BigPanda, PagerDuty, Rundeck. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with continuity management software a plus. Relevant certifications (e.g., CBCP, ABCP, ITIL Foundation) are a plus but not required.

jobs.title: Risk Analyst
jobs.location: OFF GBR: London (Sancroft)
jobs.description: Job Purpose ICE Clear Europe’s Clearing Risk Department (“CRD”) is looking for a Risk Analyst. The successful candidate will assist the senior risk managers in overseeing and shaping the risk management practice at one of the largest futures and options clearing houses in the world. You will be joining a very dynamic team, be exposed to a wide range of asset classes and be challenged with complex risk problems. You will be responsible for carrying out all aspects of the day-to-day risk management duties and assist in developing and implementing enhancements to the risk management tools, models, and processes. You will also participate in the design and implementation of new risk initiatives and products that benefit the business. Responsibilities Conduct mathematical/statistical analysis to calibrate and enhance risk models Ensure the risk management framework and risk policies are being adhered to and are consistent with regulatory and industry standards Assist with identifying areas where the risk models, risk management processes, or infrastructure can be improved Enhance documentation of risk processes, procedures and models Assist with communication with representatives from clearing members, risk committees and senior management of ICE Build and maintain risk management reports for the ICE Clear Europe board, various ICE Clear Europe risk committees and the regulators overseeing ICE Clear Europe Monitor model performance tests and assess the appropriateness of models in order to demonstrate policy adherence Collaborate with a group of colleagues on key policy and methodology development Conduct project work and run thematic or ad-hoc market research on relevant risk topics Knowledge and Experience Degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Finance or other equivalent degrees Attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills with the ability to balance trade-offs Prior experience in risk management as a risk intern or relevant professional experience (at an investment bank, hedge fund or clearing house) will be an advantage. Strong knowledge in financial derivatives products in multiple asset classes preferred Prior experience in applying risk management models and techniques such as Value at Risk models, Liquidity Risk models, backtesting and stress testing models will be an advantage. Ability to be a team player and to collaborate with other teams Ability to conduct research, analyze problems, formulate and implement solutions in an efficient, effective and independent manner Experience with SQL and Python Excellent written and verbal communication skills

jobs.description: Job Purpose The Regulatory Compliance Analyst is responsible for auditing and evaluating mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy and compliance with regulatory, investor, and rating agency requirements. Strong background in the use of computer programs used to review mortgage loans and standard knowledge of Microsoft Office product suite. jobs.title: IT Compliance Analyst
jobs.location: OFF USA: NY New York (11 Wall Street)
jobs.description: Job Purpose The New York Stock Exchange (an Intercontinental Exchange company) is growing its Information Technology Compliance (ITC) team, and we’re looking for an IT Compliance Analyst to help build what comes next. ITC owns the development, implementation, and management of NYSE’s risk-based IT compliance program, keeping our exchange technology aligned with Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) regulation, industry standards, and internal policy. You’ll work directly with regulators, senior technologists, and business leaders across NYSE and ICE, gaining a front-row view into how a top-tier exchange operates. You’ll gain the rare opportunity to learn advanced exchange technology concepts and bring your own judgment and problem-solving to take ownership in a fast-moving regulatory environment, where the details really matter. Responsibilities Support efforts responding to external regulatory examinations and requests of NYSE’s IT systems, policies, and processes, often working across multiple business units under tight deadlines. Own activities that keep NYSE compliant with SEC Regulation Systems Compliance and Integrity (Reg SCI) and similar frameworks, adhering to strict reporting deadlines. Act as a connective thread between business, technology, regulatory, and legal teams to keep compliance objectives moving. Advise stakeholders on IT compliance topics that are often technically complex, translating between disciplines. Keep leadership informed through ongoing monitoring and reporting of compliance status. Dig into technical assessments of new systems, system changes, and software defects, spotting regulatory, operational, and functional risk and proposing compensating controls. Knowledge and Experience 3+ years of experience in one or more of: IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) IT SDLC or business analysis IT audit or controls assurance Government or industry regulator role focused on technology compliance Equities and options markets, automated trading, or low-latency market data Regulatory compliance more broadly, ideally in financial services and/or fintech Relevant certifications a plus (ISACA, ISC², ITIL, etc.). Solid grounding in IT risk and control frameworks (COBIT, ISO, NIST, ITIL) and the ability to apply them to real exchange systems. Comfort reading and interpreting financial securities regulation. A self-starter: you’re energized by ambiguity, not stalled by it, and you bring good judgment and instinct to unfamiliar problems, proactively flagging what needs a closer look. Reliable follow-through: you take direction and run with it while knowing when to self-solve or escalate, never working on assumptions. Quick to learn: you often get it the first time, ask when you don’t, and move on to what’s next. Flexibility to be available outside traditional business hours when markets or regulatory deadlines demand it. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the versatility to explain complex technical topics to very different audiences. Interest in bringing automation to compliance workflows and data analysis (Python, AI tools, etc.). Experience is great, but willingness to learn is essential. New York Base Salary Range The expected base salary for this role, if located in New York, is between $100,000 - 130,000 USD.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. Regular full-time ICE employees are eligible for a suite of competitive employee benefits, including healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), a 401(k) plan, life insurance, time off, and paid leave for qualifying circumstances. Regular full-time ICE employees are eligible for a suite of competitive employee benefits, including healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), a 401(k) plan, life insurance, time off, and paid leave for qualifying circumstances. jobs.title: Senior Trade Operations Analyst
jobs.location: OFF IND: TG Hyderabad (Skyview)
jobs.description: Job Purpose Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Operations offers market knowledge, technical expertise, customer service, and innovative tools to support our global functions. Systems, Network, and Trading Operations, Internal IT Support, Information Security, Client Services, and Data Centers all enable our business to run smoothly, securely, and efficiently. ICE Trade Operations is part of a support organization that is responsible for the daily operations of multiple industry leading derivatives exchanges. The team provides first-line support for customers who use our proprietary trading systems and conduct real time trade surveillance of our futures markets. As the primary touchpoint for customers, we ensure they can quickly and efficiently support the trades and operations essential to their business. The Trade Operations Analyst is the front line for our trading platform customers. The Trade Operations Analyst is well-versed in our products, markets, and operations, and is pivotal to ICE’s commitment to strong customer service, integrity, and transparency in the financial marketplaces. Responsibilities Conduct real-time surveillance of electronic trading activity in ICE Futures products Manage real-time Exchange prices and price controls to allow orderly market trading Calculate accurate daily and final settlement prices that are used as benchmark reference prices and by ICE's clearinghouses to manage participant risk Provide training on the ICE website, trading platform functionality, and specific trading information for OTC and futures markets Provide quick responsiveness to customers, offering functionality support and troubleshooting to resolve issues Support both new and existing companies in efficient use of our proprietary systems, resolving issues, problem-solving, and training Monitor the health and usage of our systems, escalating recurring or high-priority issues Produce operational reports to provide metrics and tracking of queries Knowledge and Experience College degree or equivalent work experience in a customer-focused environment Knowledge of commodity markets, financial trading, or equity brokerage business; exposure to futures markets a plus Outstanding problem-solving and analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to multitask Strong communication skills with demonstrated interpersonal skills Team player, with commitment to service to our customers and their needs Working knowledge of at least one of Salesforce, ServiceNow, MS Office
